name: AK37 - Slim Breathalyser & Alcohol Tester (Breath Alcohol), AAA Battery, 15mm Thick
highlights: Fifteen Millimetres, Twenty-Eight Grams — The thinnest and lightest device in the entire catalogue. It goes in a wallet pocket or a sun visor and is forgotten until it is needed.
Runs on Two AAA Cells — No charging, no USB port, no flat battery on the night it matters. Cells are available in every petrol station in the world, which is the point.
Ready When It Is Picked Up — A device used a few times a year is the worst possible candidate for a rechargeable cell. Dry cells hold their charge on a shelf for years.
Retail-Friendly Format — Colour box and manual, no cable — a simpler and cheaper retail pack than the rechargeable models.
100 Per Carton — 425 × 422 × 310 mm outer, 11.3 kg gross.
